title: Gigantes Plaki (Greek Giant Beans)
description: A hearty and flavorful Greek dish made with giant beans in a rich tomato sauce. Serve as a side or main course.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, tomato paste, beef broth, salt, and pepper.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let sauce simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the giant beans to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Continue to simmer for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
